description: Rastrelliere per biciclette is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Localizzazione delle rastrelliere per il parcheggio delle biciclette nell'area urbana di Bologna. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. Its keywords are Mobilità persone e merci, infrastrutture, piano dei quartieri. The portal shows 824 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
